context: Serial item. GUARDRAILS: read-only GitHub API use with the default token; no new secrets; the scheduled job must not hold more than 1 runner. No DECISION GATE beyond normal review.
description: The dev-loop v2 targets (fast tier p95 <= 7 min, medium tier p95 <= 15 min, red trunk 0, flaky retry rate < 2%, workflow count) were never measured; dlv2-84 and dlv2-30day-metrics are open and unstarted. The retrospective had to sample gh data by hand. Build a script (scripts/, no new service) that computes the metrics from the GitHub API for a date window and writes a Markdown report, plus a weekly scheduled job that uploads it as an artifact. Extra metrics: CI first-pass green, PR open->merge p50/p90, runner-hours by workflow, release lead time (rc tag to PyPI), trunk UAT pass rate and per-cell infrastructure-failure rate, process-induced blocker count (from tracker items tagged by rv2r-04).
